institution: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) — joint international degree with Université Libre de Bruxelles (coordinator)
programme_name: Máster Universitario Erasmus Mundus en Gestión y Análisis de Datos Masivos (BDMA)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL, conjunto internacional) — BUT SEE THE TRANSITION WARNING. TWO RUCT codes exist for this name and they must not be confused: 4317908 'Publicado en B.O.E.' (ACTIVE — consortium UPC; CentraleSupélec FR; TU Eindhoven NL; Università degli Studi di Padova IT; ULB BE), verificado 01/03/2022, BOE 28/10/2022, MECES 3, Máster RD 1393/2007, CCAA Cataluña; and 4317203 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR)' (the older consortium with Technische Universität Berlin instead of Padova). The live registration is 4317908.
ects: 120 ECTS over 2 academic years (RUCT Créditos Totales 120; UPC FIB page: '2 academic years', '120 ECTS credits')
modality: Presencial with compulsory international mobility — a joint programme delivered across five universities; students move between institutions. 30 places.
language_of_instruction: 'English' — stated verbatim on the UPC FIB programme page. Entry requires English 'the level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages'. No Spanish requirement for teaching. NOTE: the UPC FIB page at the BDMA URL now renders the SUCCESSOR programme's content (see notes), so this English statement is sourced to that page as it stands today.
tuition_total_eur: 18,000 EUR total for a non-EU (Partner Country) student = '€9000 / year' x 2 years. The EU/resident (Programme Country) price is '€4500 / year' = 9,000 EUR total. Fees 'include national enrolment fees and the insurance cost'. The consortium sets one price for all five universities: 'tuition fees are determined by the University Consortium that organizes the studies. These fees are the same for all the participating universities.'
tuition_population: non-EU (Partner Country) — the 18,000 EUR figure. Tunisia is a Partner Country, so this is the applicable rate.
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT DATED ON THE PAGE — the BDMA tuition page states the €4500/€9000 per-year rates without naming a cohort or academic year. Recorded as undated rather than assigned to a year I cannot source.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and large: the non-EU (Partner Country) rate is exactly DOUBLE the EU (Programme Country) rate, €9,000/yr vs €4,500/yr. This is the Erasmus Mundus two-tier structure, not a Catalan decree surcharge. CRITICAL OFFSET: the Erasmus Mundus scholarship for Partner Country students covers 'Participation costs: up to 9,000 euros per year' in full, plus 'Travel costs: 2.000 or 3,000 euros per year', 'Installation costs: 1,000 euros', and 'Contribution to subsistence costs: 1,000 euros per month ... (24 months maximum)'. A scholarship holder pays zero tuition.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE (RUCT 4317908): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT ('Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is null in output/ruct-detail.jsonl — not 0). FOR THE APPLICANT (UPC FIB admission text): no complementos scheme; the stated bar is 'a Bachelor of Science (or degree equivalent to 180 ECTS credits), with a major in Computer Science' plus English B2. A 300-ECTS software engineering degree comfortably exceeds the 180-ECTS floor — no bridging implied, and no advanced standing offered either (the 120 ECTS is fixed).
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for a September 2027 intake, and probably will not be under this name — see notes. Dates actually found, each with its own cohort marked: (a) BDMA's own admission page still shows the 2024-2026 cohort — grant-period deadline 'December 22nd, 2023 (at noon GMT time)', self-funded non-EU 'April 30th, 2024', self-funded EU 'June 30th, 2024'; (b) the successor DEAI programme's first cohort (2026-2028) applied 21 October 2025 – 13 January 2026 for non-EU/scholarship candidates. NOTHING for 2027 entry is published. Note the shape that will recur: the scholarship round closes in mid-JANUARY, roughly eight months before the September start, so a September 2027 candidate would need to apply around Oct 2026–Jan 2027.
notes: ⚠️ MAY NOT RUN UNDER THIS NAME FOR SEPT 2027 — the most important finding on this record. UPC's own DTIM research group publishes a news item headed 'End of the 7th Edition of the BDMA Master + Transition to DEAI', and UPC FIB's page AT THE BDMA URL now serves content for 'Erasmus Mundus Master in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence' (DEAI) instead. ULB (the coordinator) announced 'the new Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Degree in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (DEAI) has been selected for funding by the European Commission under the Erasmus+ Programme', with the first cohort 2026-2028. The DEAI consortium is ALSO DIFFERENT — ULB, UPC, Technische Universität Wien, Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1, Università degli Studi di Padova — i.e. TU Eindhoven and CentraleSupélec are out, TU Wien and Lyon 1 are in. That means DEAI is a NEW title needing its OWN Spanish registration: I searched output/ruct-backbone.jsonl for 'Data Engineering' and 'Ingeniería de Datos' and there is NO RUCT row for DEAI, so its Spanish official status is UNVERIFIED as of 2026-08-25 and must be re-checked before anyone relies on it. RUCT 4317908 remains 'Publicado en B.O.E.' — the register has not yet caught up with the teaching reality, which is exactly why registry state alone is not proof a programme admits students. Fetch failures logged honestly: deai.ulb.be returned HTTP 503 twice and dtim.upc.edu returned a header-overflow parse error, so the DEAI consortium composition and the DEAI fee page are search-index-derived, not directly read. The €9,000/€4,500 figures ARE directly read, from BDMA's own fee page.

official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL). RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', nivel 'Máster - RD 1393/2007', MECES 3, verificado 08/07/2015, BOE 26/10/2016, CCAA Cataluña. Note there is an OLDER, superseded MASTEAM registration — 4311690 'Máster Universitario en Ingeniería y Gestión de las Telecomunicaciones - Masteam', estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR)' — do not cite that one.
ects: 60 — UPC page: '1 academic year, 60 ECTS credits'. RUCT Créditos Totales 60.
modality: Presencial / face-to-face at EETAC Castelldefels, with afternoon or morning schedules depending on the intake semester. TWO INTAKES PER YEAR: September and February. Places: '20 in September and 10 in February'.
language_of_instruction: English — stated as the language of instruction on UPC's own programme page. Entry requires an 'English language certificate at Level B2 or above' (Cambridge FCE, TOEFL, IELTS or equivalent). No Spanish requirement stated — this is one of the few programmes in this batch that does not filter out an A0/A1-Spanish candidate.
tuition_total_eur: 2,700 EUR tuition for a non-EU non-resident student = 60 credits x 45,00 EUR/credit (1st enrolment). UPC's price page gives an 'estimated price' of 3,200 EUR once additional academic fees are included. The EU/resident equivalent is 19,37 EUR/credit x 60 = 1,162.20 EUR (estimated 1,600 EUR with fees).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the UPC price table sits under the heading 'Másteres universitarios 2026-2027'; the table itself does not restate the year, so this is inferred from the page's own section heading and is flagged as such.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and structural. UPC publishes a distinct 'no residentes, no UE' row for másteres at 45,00 EUR/credit (1st enrolment; 60,00 EUR 2nd, 100,00 EUR 3rd, 128,00 EUR 4th) against the general non-habilitante rate of 19,37 EUR/credit. IMPORTANT MECHANIC, and the exact point round 1 got wrong: the 45 EUR is the TOTAL differentiated per-credit price for non-EU students, NOT a surcharge added on top of 19,37. So the non-EU price is ~2.3x the resident price, not 3.3x. Exemptions UPC lists: EU nationals, family members of EU citizens, holders of a family-reunification residence permit, nationals of Iceland/Liechtenstein/Norway/Switzerland, nationals of Andorra and China (reciprocity), and 'Estudiantes extranjeros de otros países que puedan demostrar una residencia permanente en España'. A Tunisian on a study stay qualifies for NONE of these — and per Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 a long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status, so the 45 EUR rate applies and cannot be escaped by moving to Barcelona first.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE (RUCT 4315535): 0 (RUCT) — no compulsory bridging credits built into the title. FOR THE APPLICANT (UPC MASTEAM admission page): no complementos scheme is published, but the stated entry bar is 'an official bachelor's degree in telecommunications or ICT engineering (240+ ECTS credits)'. A 300-ECTS software engineering degree exceeds the 240-ECTS bar; whether a software (rather than telecom/ICT) engineering title is accepted without complementos is NOT stated and would need the school to rule on it. No credit-recognition/advanced-standing offer was found.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. CONFLICT worth flagging between two UPC sources for 2026-27: the MASTEAM programme page states 'Pre-enrolment is currently closed', while an UPC school (EPSEB) news page advertises a 2026-2027 preinscripción window of 18 February 2026 to 1 February 2027 covering both the autumn (September) and spring (February) entry semesters. Per-school calendars evidently differ, so the general UPC window cannot be assumed to be MASTEAM's. Preinscripción fee ~30,21 EUR. Record as 2026-27; do not shift these to 2027.
notes: Independently re-sourced. RUCT code CONFIRMED ON UPC'S OWN PAGE, which prints 'SC code 4315535' — the strongest form of confirmation available and it matches the register exactly; no reliance on a fuzzy matcher. The tuition figure quoted is the NON-EU one (2,700 EUR / 3,200 EUR with fees). Two intakes a year is a practical advantage for a candidate whose degree completes in August 2026: a February start is available as a fallback if the September round is missed. The February intake carries only 10 places against 20 in September.

official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL). RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', nivel académico 'Máster - RD 822/2021 (3)' — i.e. verified under the current decree, not the legacy RD 1393/2007 — MECES 3, verificado 24/11/2023, BOE 27/09/2024, CCAA Cataluña.
ects: 90 — UPC page: '1.5 academic years, 90 ECTS credits'; RUCT Créditos Totales 90. Three semesters, ending in an 18-credit thesis.
language_of_instruction: 'English' — stated verbatim as the language on UPC's own programme page. No Spanish requirement stated, so an A0/A1-Spanish candidate is not excluded on language.
tuition_total_eur: 4,050 EUR tuition for a non-EU non-resident student = 90 credits x 45,00 EUR/credit (1st enrolment); UPC's programme page independently states 'approximately €4,050 for non-EU residents (excluding additional administrative costs)'. The EU/resident equivalent is approximately 1,743 EUR (90 x 19,37 = 1,743.30).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — UPC's price table sits under the heading 'Másteres universitarios 2026-2027'; the table itself does not restate the year, so the year attribution is from the section heading and is flagged as such.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit. UPC's differentiated price for 'no residentes, no UE' on másteres is 45,00 EUR/credit at 1st enrolment (60,00 2nd, 100,00 3rd, 128,00 4th) versus 19,37 EUR/credit for the general non-habilitante rate. The 45 EUR is the TOTAL non-EU per-credit price, not an amount added to 19,37 — the programme page's own two figures (1,743 vs 4,050) confirm this arithmetic. Exemptions do not reach a Tunisian study-visa holder, and a Spanish long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status (Catalonia Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5).
complementary_credits_required: THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FIELD ON THIS RECORD, and the two levels disagree in the way the brief warns about. FOR THE TITLE (RUCT 3500034): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is null in output/ruct-detail.jsonl, which is not the same as 0. FOR THE APPLICANT (UPC programme page, admission section): complementos ARE explicitly imposed on some backgrounds — candidates holding one of six specified ICT-related bachelor's degrees get direct admission, while holders of Industrial Electronics, Industrial Technology or Electrical Engineering degrees are admitted 'requiring up to 18 ECTS bridging courses', and other qualifications are assessed case by case. A Tunisian software engineering title is not on either named list, so it falls in the case-by-case bucket and a bridging requirement of up to 18 ECTS is a live risk that must be resolved with the school before committing — 300 ECTS of prior study does not automatically neutralise it, because the rule keys on subject match, not on credit volume.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. The programme page states pre-enrolment is 'Currently closed' and directs candidates to an information-request form for future periods. For context only, and marked as 2026-27: an UPC school (EPSEB) advertises a general 2026-2027 preinscripción window of 18 February 2026 to 1 February 2027, but per-school calendars differ and that window is not confirmed for EPSEM. Preinscripción fee ~30,21 EUR. Dates NOT shifted forward.
notes: Independently re-sourced. RUCT code CONFIRMED ON UPC'S OWN PAGE ('RUCT Code: 3500034'), matching the register exactly — no fuzzy-matcher reliance. Tuition quoted is the NON-EU figure. Two structural points a ranking should carry: (1) 90 ECTS over 1.5 years means an extra semester of living costs and a mid-year finish, unlike the 60-ECTS one-year masters elsewhere in this batch; (2) it is English-taught, which together with MASTEAM and AI4CI makes UPC the language-viable cluster for this candidate.

institution: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) — Escola d'Enginyeria de Telecomunicació i Aeroespacial de Castelldefels (EETAC)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Inteligencia Artificial para Industrias Conectadas (AI4CI)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL). RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', nivel académico 'Máster - RD 822/2021 (3)', MECES 3, verificado 12/12/2024, BOE 01/10/2025, CCAA Cataluña. This is the newest verification in the batch — a 2024 verification published in BOE only in October 2025.
ects: 120 — UPC page: '2 academic years, 120 ECTS credits'; RUCT Créditos Totales 120.
modality: 'Face-to-face' (presencial) at EETAC Castelldefels; UPC also notes most subjects are face-to-face with some optional subjects taught online. TWO INTAKES: September and February. 25 places.
language_of_instruction: 'English' — stated verbatim as the language on UPC's own programme page. The master is described as international in nature, taught with several European universities and with company participation.
tuition_total_eur: 5,400 EUR tuition for a non-EU non-resident student — figure printed on UPC's own programme page as 'Non-EU residents: €5,400', consistent with 120 credits x 45,00 EUR/credit. The EU/resident equivalent printed alongside is '€2,324' (120 x 19,37 = 2,324.40). Both exclude 'non-teaching academic fees and degree certificate costs'.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — UPC's price table sits under the heading 'Másteres universitarios 2026-2027'. Relevant history: UPC REDUCED the non-EU master's per-credit price to 45 EUR for first enrolment as of June 2025 (UPC press room: 'The UPC reduces tuition fees for non-EU students enrolling in master's degrees'), so older figures found elsewhere for this programme will be higher and should not be trusted.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit, and the largest absolute gap in this batch because the programme is 120 ECTS: 5,400 EUR non-EU vs 2,324 EUR EU/resident, a difference of 3,076 EUR over the degree. Mechanism: UPC publishes 45,00 EUR/credit as the TOTAL differentiated 'no residentes, no UE' price at 1st enrolment (60,00 2nd, 100,00 3rd, 128,00 4th), not an add-on to the 19,37 EUR general rate. None of UPC's exemptions (EU nationals, EU family members, family-reunification permit holders, Iceland/Liechtenstein/Norway/Switzerland, Andorra and China by reciprocity, or permanent residence in Spain) reach a Tunisian student-visa holder, and a long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status (Catalonia Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5).
complementary_credits_required: THE TWO LEVELS DISAGREE — this is the field to read carefully. FOR THE TITLE (RUCT 3500437): 0 (RUCT) — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0, so no bridging credits are built into the title. FOR THE APPLICANT (UPC AI4CI admission section): bridging courses ARE imposed on most non-telecom backgrounds. Direct admission is for 'Bachelor's degrees in the field of telecommunications engineering'; bridging courses are required for Data Engineering, Industrial Electronics and Automatic Control Engineering, INFORMATICS ENGINEERING, Aerospace Systems Engineering and Artificial Intelligence degrees; all other candidates 'undergo individual assessment by the academic committee'. A software/informatics engineering graduate is therefore in the BRIDGING category by the school's own list, notwithstanding the 0 in RUCT and notwithstanding 300 ECTS of prior study — the rule keys on subject, not on credit volume. The ECTS quantum of the bridging is not published on the page; NOT FOUND.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. UPC's programme page states verbatim 'Pre-enrolment for this master's degree is currently closed' and points to an information-request form for the next period. For context only and marked as 2026-27: an UPC school (EPSEB) advertises a general 2026-2027 preinscripción window of 18 February 2026 to 1 February 2027 spanning both the September and February entry semesters; per-school calendars differ and this is not confirmed for EETAC. Preinscripción fee ~30,21 EUR. Dates NOT shifted forward by a year.
notes: Independently re-sourced. RUCT code CONFIRMED ON UPC'S OWN PAGE ('RUCT Code: 3500437'), matching the register — no fuzzy-matcher reliance. Tuition quoted is the NON-EU figure; the EU figure is given alongside so the two can never be confused downstream. Academic coordinator: Carles Gómez Montenegro. Practical ranking notes: 120 ECTS over two years is double the exposure to the non-EU rate and double the living costs versus the 60-ECTS options, but it also gives two September intakes' worth of scheduling slack and a February fallback start; and the RD 822/2021 verification means it is a current-decree title with a fresh accreditation, not a legacy one running on renewals.
